title: Who is the Agent to Blame? Localizing Faithfulness and Citation Mistakes in Agentic Deep Research

live_model.evidence: Sec. 4.2.1: 'The LLM used as the judge is gpt-5-mini-2025-08-07 (Singh et al., 2026). The full prompts are provided in Section B.'

prompt.location: Appendix B (judge prompts for span extraction, citation identification, entailment)
prompt.note: Prompts belong to the error-localization judge, not to a subject model.

claim.metric: judge vs arbitrated human labels: exact match (%)
claim.location: Sec. 4.3 Results: '76% exact matches and kappa=0.62' on 50 AI-Q sentences

data.source: DeepResearch Bench (Apache-2.0) English examples 51-100; DR outputs, tracing logs and annotations released with the code (https://github.com/eranhirs/)

notes: Live model is the judge (role A). GPT-5 mini also runs as reporter/researcher inside MS-Agent, but those reports depend on live web search (Tavily) and the agent framework, so no subject-role number is re-runnable without code.
